title: security(rbac): RBAC v2 - enforce KMS region pinning and audit logging enhancements
author: Asha Nair
commits: 9a4b2c2 - enforce: add KMS region pinning check to RBAC v2 policy evaluator
3d7f8e1 - audit: emit structured audit events for KMS region mismatch attempts
5b6a7f0 - tests: add unit and integration tests for region pinning
0f1e2d3 - docs: add KMS region residency guidance and upgrade notes
2c3b4a5 - ci: add config validation step for KMS residency policy
description:
Context: Customers in regulated industries require cryptographic keys to remain in specific geographic regions. RBAC v1 allowed certain KMS operations that unintentionally permitted cross-region key references. This PR extends RBAC v2 to (1) enforce KMS region pinning on resources that declare residency constraints, (2) emit structured audit logs for any KMS region mismatch attempts, and (3) add validation/CI checks to prevent misconfiguration.

What changed (high-level):
- Enforce KMS region pinning in the policy evaluator: services/rbac-v2/policies/kms_region_pinning.go implements the residency check and a configurable enforcement mode (audit|enforce).
- Audit logging enhancements: audit_handler.go now emits structured JSON events with fields (actor, resource_id, requested_kms_key, key_region, expected_region, decision, reason).
- CI/validation: scripts/ci/validate-kms-config.sh added to fail builds when tenant configs refer to unsupported regions or lack residency tags.
- CLI / operator tooling: rbacctl adds a 'pin-kms-region' command to help operators migrate existing bindings.
- Tests and docs: unit + integration tests, e2e fixture, and docs/security/kms-region-residency.md with upgrade steps and roll-out guidance.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add policy-level enforcement with toggle (audit/enforce)
- [x] Emit structured audit events for mismatches
- [x] Add unit and integration tests
- [x] Add CI validation script to catch misconfigs
- [x] Update docs and operator CLI
- [x] Coordinate rollout plan with infra and SRE

Files changed (representative snippets):
- services/rbac-v2/policies/kms_region_pinning.go: added EvaluateKMSResidency which checks keyRegion == expectedRegion and returns decision with reason.
- services/rbac-v2/audit/audit_handler.go: added formatAuditEvent(KMSRegionMismatchEvent) and wired it into the evaluator.
- scripts/ci/validate-kms-config.sh: new pre-merge check used in pipeline.

Testing:
- Unit tests cover positive/negative residency cases and enforcement toggle.
- Integration tests simulate tenant bindings and a mock KMS returning region metadata.
- E2E run in staging validated that audit-only mode logged mismatches without blocking, then we flipped to enforce in a controlled canary (10% tenants) and monitored for errors.

Review conversation (summary):
- @LiamOC asked for clearer field names in the audit payload; switched requested_kms_key -> kms_key_arn and added key_region and expected_region as top-level fields.
- @Priya requested a migration helper for existing bindings; added rbacctl pin-kms-region command and documented operator steps.
- @Ethan asked for a CI guard to prevent accidental rollouts; added scripts/ci/validate-kms-config.sh and a pipeline gate.
- Minor nits addressed (naming, comments, and a log level tweak).

CI: initial run had a lint failure (line length) which was fixed in 3d7f8e1; subsequent pipeline passed all checks including unit/integration tests and policy linters.

Rollout plan:
1) Merge to main in audit-only mode (default)
2) Monitor audit metrics and alerts (observability/alerts/kms-audit-rules.yaml) for 1 week
3) Enable enforcement for a 10% canary cohort via feature flag and monitor
4) Gradually expand to 100% if no regressions

Backwards compatibility and safety: The enforcement behavior is behind a feature flag and RBAC v2 policy config can explicitly opt into region residency. For customers that rely on cross-region keys we document migration steps and provide the CLI helper.

Related: ENG-4521 (policy workstream), SEC-119 (KMS residency), SUP-8421 (customer support case referencing cross-region key exposure).

Merge: squashed and merged after approvals.

- Operator CLI helper for migration
